credit_entries_signs_check.name: credit_entries_signs_check
credit_entries_signs_check.value:
(
        ("credit_entries"."kind" = 'credit'  AND "credit_entries"."balance_delta_micro" > 0 AND "credit_entries"."held_delta_micro" = 0) OR
        ("credit_entries"."kind" = 'reserve' AND "credit_entries"."balance_delta_micro" = 0 AND "credit_entries"."held_delta_micro" > 0) OR
        ("credit_entries"."kind" = 'settle'  AND "credit_entries"."balance_delta_micro" <= 0 AND "credit_entries"."held_delta_micro" < 0 AND "credit_entries"."balance_delta_micro" >= "credit_entries"."held_delta_micro") OR
        ("credit_entries"."kind" = 'release' AND "credit_entries"."balance_delta_micro" = 0 AND "credit_entries"."held_delta_micro" < 0) OR
        ("credit_entries"."kind" IN ('refund','dispute','expire','overage') AND "credit_entries"."balance_delta_micro" < 0 AND "credit_entries"."held_delta_micro" = 0)
      )

promo_codes_duration_check.name: promo_codes_duration_check
promo_codes_duration_check.value: "promo_codes"."duration" IN ('once', 'repeating', 'forever') AND ("promo_codes"."duration" <> 'repeating' OR ("promo_codes"."duration_months" IS NOT NULL AND "promo_codes"."duration_months" BETWEEN 1 AND 36))

promo_codes_value_check.name: promo_codes_value_check
promo_codes_value_check.value:
(
        ("promo_codes"."kind" = 'percent' AND "promo_codes"."percent_off" IS NOT NULL AND "promo_codes"."percent_off" BETWEEN 1 AND 100) OR
        ("promo_codes"."kind" = 'amount' AND "promo_codes"."amount_off_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "promo_codes"."amount_off_cents" > 0) OR
        ("promo_codes"."kind" = 'trial' AND "promo_codes"."trial_days" IS NOT NULL AND "promo_codes"."trial_days" BETWEEN 1 AND 365) OR
        ("promo_codes"."kind" IN ('free', 'staff'))
      )

promo_codes_limits_check.name: promo_codes_limits_check
promo_codes_limits_check.value: ("promo_codes"."max_redemptions" IS NULL OR "promo_codes"."max_redemptions" > 0) AND ("promo_codes"."min_amount_cents" IS NULL OR "promo_codes"."min_amount_cents" > 0)

proxmox_servers_tls_check.name: proxmox_servers_tls_check
proxmox_servers_tls_check.value: "proxmox_servers"."tls_mode" IN ('verify', 'pinned') AND ("proxmox_servers"."tls_mode" <> 'pinned' OR "proxmox_servers"."tls_fingerprint" IS NOT NULL)

vps_apps_script_check.name: vps_apps_script_check
vps_apps_script_check.value:
(
        ("vps_apps"."kind" = 'installable' AND "vps_apps"."install_script" IS NOT NULL
          AND "vps_apps"."install_script_sha256" = encode(sha256(convert_to("vps_apps"."install_script", 'UTF8')), 'hex'))
        OR ("vps_apps"."kind" = 'guide' AND "vps_apps"."install_script" IS NULL AND "vps_apps"."install_script_sha256" IS NULL)
      )

vps_instances_server_vmid_unique.name: vps_instances_server_vmid_unique
vps_instances_server_vmid_unique.where: "vps_instances"."vmid" IS NOT NULL AND "vps_instances"."deleted_at" IS NULL

vps_instances_server_ip_unique.name: vps_instances_server_ip_unique
vps_instances_server_ip_unique.where: "vps_instances"."ipv4" IS NOT NULL AND "vps_instances"."deleted_at" IS NULL

vps_plans_price_pos.name: vps_plans_price_pos
vps_plans_price_pos.value: ("vps_plans"."price_monthly_cents" IS NULL OR "vps_plans"."price_monthly_cents" > 0) AND ("vps_plans"."price_yearly_cents" IS NULL OR "vps_plans"."price_yearly_cents" > 0)
